units.source_text: 对弈者和工作人员都闲居在旅馆里，白白地度过郁闷的日子。

en.t: The players and staff all stayed idly at the inn, passing gloomy days in vain.

units.source_text: 因此名人曾到川奈去散心。

en.t: For that reason, the Master once went to Kawana to clear his mind.

units.source_text: 名人本来不爱出门，现在却自己主动出去了，这十分罕见。

en.t: The Master normally disliked going out, yet now he had gone out of his own accord, which was extremely rare.

units.source_text: 名人及他的弟子村岛五段、负责记录的少女棋手和我同行。

en.t: The Master, his disciple Murashima fifth dan, the young female player in charge of recording the moves, and I went together.
